title: Race condition between Unity counter service and autostarted apps, causing them to sometimes lose their Task Manager notification badges until they're restarted
line: Apps that start automatically at login now keep the unread-count badge they set on their Task Manager icon.
explanation: With the systemd boot, XDG autostart apps were only ordered after KWin, so they started in parallel with plasmashell. The Task Manager's com.canonical.Unity listener only exists once the shell and its panels have loaded (about 0.5 s later on the rig), so a LauncherEntry Update an app broadcast at startup had no receiver and was lost; the badge stayed missing until the app sent a new count. plasmashell now tells systemd it is ready (Type=notify, READY=1) when it releases org.kde.PlasmaLoading after loading, and a drop-in orders every app-*.service after plasma-plasmashell.service, so autostart apps start once the shell is up.

commits.message:
startkde/systemd: start autostart apps once plasmashell has loaded

Autostart apps started while plasmashell was still loading, so badge
counts they sent at startup reached no Task Manager and were lost. Make
plasmashell report ready when it finishes loading and order apps after it.

BUG: 462735

patches.diff:
From 5fdbde668a68db1e1666649aa67a01c3652005ae Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 19:05:33 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] startkde/systemd: start autostart apps once plasmashell has
 loaded

Autostart apps started while plasmashell was still loading, so badge
counts they sent at startup reached no Task Manager and were lost. Make
plasmashell report ready when it finishes loading and order apps after it.

BUG: 462735
---
 shell/CMakeLists.txt                     | 13 +++++++++++++
 shell/autotests/CMakeLists.txt           |  3 +++
 shell/config-plasma.h.cmake              |  1 +
 shell/plasma-plasmashell.service.in      |  2 +-
 shell/shellcorona.cpp                    |  7 +++++++
 startkde/systemd/CMakeLists.txt          |  1 +
 startkde/systemd/app-service-dropin.conf |  2 ++
 7 files changed, 28 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)
 create mode 100644 startkde/systemd/app-service-dropin.conf

diff --git a/shell/CMakeLists.txt b/shell/CMakeLists.txt
index 05393e8838..845547d94e 100644
--- a/shell/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/shell/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -1,5 +1,14 @@
 set(USE_SCRIPTING 1)
 
+pkg_check_modules(libsystemd IMPORTED_TARGET libsystemd)
+if(TARGET PkgConfig::libsystemd)
+    set(HAVE_SYSTEMD 1)
+    set(PLASMASHELL_SERVICE_TYPE notify)
+else()
+    set(HAVE_SYSTEMD 0)
+    set(PLASMASHELL_SERVICE_TYPE dbus)
+endif()
+
 configure_file(config-ktexteditor.h.cmake ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/config-ktexteditor.h )
 
 configure_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/config-plasma.h.cmake ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/config-plasma.h)
@@ -148,6 +157,10 @@ endif()
 target_include_directories(plasmashell PRIVATE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")
 target_compile_definitions(plasmashell PRIVATE -DPROJECT_VERSION="${PROJECT_VERSION}")
 
+if(HAVE_SYSTEMD)
+    target_link_libraries(plasmashell PRIVATE PkgConfig::libsystemd)
+endif()
+
 if(PROJECT_VERSION_PATCH GREATER_EQUAL 80 OR PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR GREATER_EQUAL 80)
     target_link_libraries(plasmashell PRIVATE KF6::KIOGui)
 endif()
diff --git a/shell/autotests/CMakeLists.txt b/shell/autotests/CMakeLists.txt
index 368cbd4542..9200d12af2 100644
--- a/shell/autotests/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/shell/autotests/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -69,6 +69,9 @@ MACRO(PLASMASHELL_UNIT_TESTS)
                if(PROJECT_VERSION_PATCH GREATER_EQUAL 80 OR PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR GREATER_EQUAL 80)
                    target_link_libraries(${_testname} KF6::KIOGui)
                endif()
+               if(HAVE_SYSTEMD)
+                   target_link_libraries(${_testname} PkgConfig::libsystemd)
+               endif()
                add_test(NAME ${_testname} COMMAND dbus-run-session $<TARGET_FILE:${_testname}>)
                set_tests_properties(${_testname} PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "QT_NO_XDG_DESKTOP_PORTAL=1")
                ecm_mark_as_test(${_testname})
diff --git a/shell/config-plasma.h.cmake b/shell/config-plasma.h.cmake
index 99fa0f67da..0ff692da74 100644
--- a/shell/config-plasma.h.cmake
+++ b/shell/config-plasma.h.cmake
@@ -1 +1,2 @@
 #cmakedefine01 USE_SCRIPTING
+#cmakedefine01 HAVE_SYSTEMD
diff --git a/shell/plasma-plasmashell.service.in b/shell/plasma-plasmashell.service.in
index 177c151e73..910044f777 100644
--- a/shell/plasma-plasmashell.service.in
+++ b/shell/plasma-plasmashell.service.in
@@ -8,7 +8,7 @@ StartLimitBurst=3
 [Service]
 ExecStart=@CMAKE_INSTALL_FULL_BINDIR@/plasmashell --no-respawn
 Restart=on-failure
-Type=dbus
+Type=@PLASMASHELL_SERVICE_TYPE@
 BusName=org.kde.plasmashell
 Slice=session.slice
 TimeoutSec=40sec
diff --git a/shell/shellcorona.cpp b/shell/shellcorona.cpp
index 51bde18ac6..63fec92637 100644
--- a/shell/shellcorona.cpp
+++ b/shell/shellcorona.cpp
@@ -54,6 +54,10 @@
 #include <KWayland/Client/registry.h>
 #include <qassert.h>
 
+#if HAVE_SYSTEMD
+#include <systemd/sd-daemon.h>
+#endif
+
 #include "alternativeshelper.h"
 #include "containmentconfigview.h"
 #include "debug.h"
@@ -1542,6 +1546,9 @@ void ShellCorona::checkAllDesktopsUiReady()
 
     qCDebug(PLASMASHELL) << "Plasma Shell startup completed";
     QDBusConnection::sessionBus().unregisterService(QStringLiteral("org.kde.PlasmaLoading"));
+#if HAVE_SYSTEMD
+    sd_notify(0, "READY=1");
+#endif
 
     m_waitingPanels.removeAll(nullptr);
     if (!m_waitingPanels.isEmpty()) {
diff --git a/startkde/systemd/CMakeLists.txt b/startkde/systemd/CMakeLists.txt
index 64e06e9f6b..55c0733040 100644
--- a/startkde/systemd/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/startkde/systemd/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 install(FILES plasma-core.target DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_SYSTEMDUSERUNITDIR})
 install(FILES plasma-workspace.target DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_SYSTEMDUSERUNITDIR})
 install(FILES plasma-workspace-wayland.target DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_SYSTEMDUSERUNITDIR})
+install(FILES app-service-dropin.conf DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_SYSTEMDUSERUNITDIR}/app-.service.d RENAME plasma-workspace.conf)
 
 add_executable(kde-systemd-start-condition kde-systemd-start-condition.cpp)
 target_link_libraries(kde-systemd-start-condition PUBLIC KF6::ConfigCore KF6::Service PlasmaAutostart)
diff --git a/startkde/systemd/app-service-dropin.conf b/startkde/systemd/app-service-dropin.conf
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..8e0443779c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/startkde/systemd/app-service-dropin.conf
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+[Unit]
+After=plasma-plasmashell.service
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Pure master: an autostarted app sent count=7 for Discover at login, but the Discover launcher has no badge
With the fix: same autostart entry, the Discover launcher shows the 7 badge after login
